subject: Pilot demo — coordinating narrow overlap for US customer + EU engineering
messages:
From: Alex Dorran <alex.dorran@midwest-retail.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Cc: Susan Park <susan.park@midwest-retail.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2027 14:12:00 -0500
Subject: Planning: pilot demo — narrow overlap windows

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Were ready to schedule a first pilot demo (30-45 minutes) to walk our SRE and platform teams through Redwoods integration and the Dedicated routing controls. The challenge for us is the overlap window with your EU engineering team — our ops folks are central US (CT) and availability is generally early morning (6:30-8:30am CT) or late evening (8:00-10:00pm CT) on weekdays.

To make scheduling easier I attached a simple availability grid. Our preferred dates are the week of Oct 11 — we can be flexible on the day if the team in Europe can do one of these narrow windows.

Questions:
- Can you confirm who from Redwood would present the architecture piece vs. who would field deep infra questions?
- Any preferences on recording? We often ask for a short recording because of the early hour for some of our folks.

Proposed rough slots (CT):
- Tue Oct 12 7:30am CT (good for execs, tight for hands-on)
- Wed Oct 13 6:45am CT (very early for us but possible)
- Thu Oct 14 8:15pm CT (late option)

Let us know if daylight-savings shifts are going to affect which times map to UTC/CEST for your EU engineers — were aware the fall DST change is coming late Oct.

Attachments: availability-grid.png (PNG)

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Dorran
Director, Platform Engineering
Midwest Retail Co.
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Dorran <alex.dorran@midwest-retail.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2027 20:03:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Planning: pilot demo — narrow overlap windows

Alex,

Appreciate the details and the grid — that helps a lot. Short answers up front:
- Presenters: I (Sergio) will run the intro and product demo; Kimberly (platform lead) will cover Dedicated routing and autoscale; Grace (SRE) will take deep infra questions.
- Recording: fine by us — happy to record and share, and we'll put a short 2-slide TL;DR summary at the top of the recording so late/early viewers can skip.

Quick timezone math so were all aligned (Oct 1213 are pre-DST switch for both regions):
- 7:30am CT (US Central, DST) = 12:30 UTC = 14:30 CEST (EU)
- 6:45am CT = 11:45 UTC = 13:45 CEST
- 8:15pm CT = 01:15 UTC (next day) = 03:15 CEST (next day) — that second option would be very late for our engineers in mainland Europe.

Given those conversions, our recommendation: Tue Oct 12 at 7:30am CT (your morning) maps to 14:30 CEST — thats within our standard working window and gives enough overlap for live Q&A.

Operational asks if we lock Tue 10/12 7:30am CT:
- Kimberly will join from Berlin (CEST). Grace will be on-call and can join earlier if a live debug trace is needed.
- We will record and post a 24-hour link; if you need a redacted copy for internal compliance let us know.
- Please add a short list of two example SRE questions you want covered so we can prepare runbooks/dashboards.

Ill propose Tue Oct 12 07:30 CT on the calendar and include a Zoom link + recording permission. If thats okay Ill CC our field CS so they can follow up on post-demo technical next steps.

Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 2 Oct 2027 09:10:00 +0200
Subject: Fwd: Planning: pilot demo — narrow overlap windows

Kim / Grace,

Forwarding Alexs availability — theyre leaning toward Tue 10/12 at 7:30am CT which is 14:30 CEST for us. Thats perfect for Kimberly to present the routing/autoscale section and for Grace to handle infra questions. A couple of operational notes:
- Kimberly: could you prepare a 6-minute deep-dive on Dedicated autoscale (metrics we emit, burst vs reserved capacity)? If you can put 3 bullets on the Drive doc Ill attach to the invite.
- Grace: please bring the short checklist we use for memory/kv cache troubleshooting — Alex asked for runbook items we can walk through quickly.
- Recording: well record; please plan to stop and redact any customer-specific logs live if they appear in a trace.

Ill add the calendar event with the Zoom link and a note about the timezone conversions so the customer sees both CT and CEST. Also attaching the availability grid they sent.

Thanks — S
